[RDSC.8.2] Reason for schemas-before-network: the runtime registers schema
metadata (slot kinds, TTL, logical flag) before it assembles the Rete nodes.
Having that metadata in place before the alpha nodes referencing those schemas
lets the runtime validate name correspondence and slot count as the network is
built.

The ordering holds because every `module_group` precedes the bundle-global
`rete_network` ([RDSC.8.1]) — so *all* schemas are registered before *any* node
is assembled, across the whole artefact rather than one module at a time.
